title: Prove a conditional GL64 parent-stock envelope for the selected BIT bootstrap
body:
## Claim and scope

Under the selected supplier's **retained full-cover and completed ordinary-leaf interfaces**, the PR589 nine-stage BIT stopped producer has

\[
\log_q S(e,w)\le8194\,w(1+\log_2 e).
\]

This gives an explicit numerical parent-stock coefficient for PR1965's H3 at the first native bootstrap stage. Its recorded cutoff `L=4785575287428` passes the sufficient stock-fit guard with `sigma=8194` and `ceil(log2(8*sigma))=17`, so `ceil(log_q S(e,w))<e/2` for every integer `e>=2^L`, with the selected `w=ceil(e^s)`.

**This is a conditional space implication, not a new supplier, new κ, proof of H2, physical all-size implementation, or adoption of the outer proof.** The selected frontier and all predecessor files are unchanged.

## What is new

PR1956 and PR1965 distinguish carried time constants from stock constants; PR1990 independently checks the cutoff headroom and leaves the actual selected reserve coefficient uncomputed. This contribution derives that coefficient from the selected **ordinary BIT producer**, rather than importing the historical `m=120` coefficient or treating the external `252` allowance as an internal reserve.

The selected assembler uses `BIT_M=64`; the separate complex supplier has `m=73` and constrains the atom exponent `s`. The selected PR589 receipt has 28,416 live roles, 28,425 physical roles, and maximum child rank 42. The old row pricer already contains `2*(64^2+1)=8194`; novelty is the quantified divisor/depth/restoration implication that makes this a stopped-parent envelope, not that arithmetic or the already known headroom.

## Proof and domain

Fix an eligible odd prime `q>2^80`, positive integers `e,w`, and `0<=n<=e` coarse atoms. Retain the selected compiler/hosting interpretation with one complete physical-role packet per active coarse level and internally completed ordinary leaves.

1. The actual complete packet divisor is `W_q(w)=28425*|GL_64(F_q)|*q^(4096*(w-1))`. Reduction modulo `q` gives the local-ring cardinality, hence `log_q W_q(w)<4096*w+1<=4097*w`. High matrix fibers and all nine extra physical roles are charged; moment normalization does not remove row stock.
2. Every good child is at most `42*floor(n/64)`; conservative fallback children are at most `floor(n/64)`. Since `2*42^2=3528<4096`, two levels halve. The active internal depth satisfies `D(n)<=2*ceil(log2 n)` without an unnamed additive constant.
3. `S=W_q(w)^D` is a divisible reserve. A node exposes one role packet and passes the unused quotient to its children. Completed children restore it, so siblings, residuals and the two ordinary-wrapper calls reuse the same reserve. Completed ordinary leaves borrow internally and contribute external factor one, as in the reviewed PR185 contract. This is not a bound on their internal memory or time.
4. These yield `sigma=8194`. Exact rational binding to the first selected native stage checks `L*delta^2>=36`, `L*delta>=2*(4+17)` and `0<delta<=1-s`. PR1965's sufficient fit lemma applies. Its known guard headroom is 6,562,783 bits; that comparison is not claimed as new.

The proof expressly retains the full-cover/physical-slot realization, fresh-field and completed-leaf interfaces. A finite receipt does not prove them. If an old leaf requires an external factor, or a child fails to restore its row, the no-extra-factor conclusion fails; the controls exercise both countermodels. H2's time/descriptor bound and all other all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, hosting, precision/tape, recovery and analytic obligations remain open.

## Evidence and reproduction

Package: `research/selected-bit-parent-reserve/` (proof, source/task/selection metadata, exact receipt, verifier and controls).

Observed locally with standard-library CPython 3.12:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-parent-reserve
```

Output includes:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_PARENT_RESERVE m=64 sigma=8194 stage=1 floor_cases=20001 local_rings=3 row_states=27
Ran 14 tests
OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-bit-parent-reserve outcome=completed
```

The replay authenticates every external source and the immutable archive member before semantic use; no predecessor Python is executed. It compares a canonical regenerated receipt, independently checks the floor-depth recurrence on 20,001 atom counts, enumerates three small local-ring cases, and checks arbitrary-row restoration/reuse. Fourteen tests pass under `-O`, including wrong producer, lost work roles, false halving, missing high fibers, insufficient divisible stock, external-leaf and restoration countermodels, source/member corruption and cutoff mutations. The all-width claim rests on the written proof, not those finite examples. No full selected cold replay, formal kernel, or hosted-CI success is claimed.

title: Research: exact rational frame floor on four roles

## Result

This package proves the exact paid-call minimum for one four-register target in a fixed torsion-free additive address model. The four rank-one rational addresses are `A`, `B`, `P`, and `Q=A+B-P`; the target is `diag([A+P],[A+Q],[B+P],[B+Q])`. A direct word uses eight calls. title: Prove a QQ16 first-forward A logger obstruction
body:
## Result and changed premise

This proves a scoped **changed-first-forward QQ16 obstruction**, not a new supplier or κ. Let the first source map `G` be any invertible homogeneous linear encoder satisfying

```
f = B0 X_U + ell_(0,A) X + ell_(0,T) X
X'_U = X_U - K_(0,U) f
X'_T = P_(0,T) f
Y'_U = Y_U + X'_U
Y'_S = X_S + Y_S - X'_S,  S=A union T.
```

Its A output may change arbitrarily and may read every ordinary source coordinate. No independent output/transcript or unrestored helper is retained. Keep the original `B_1_2`, ordinary tail and native terminal types; later homogeneous selected-only controls cannot read ordinary banks. Observations are all selected endpoints, completed-X descendants and all five forward query histories.

**Every such G fails restoration of both arbitrary initial selected inputs from these observations.** This closes a concrete first-forward design direction under priority revision 4, while leaving changed T records, ordinary responses, B1 maps and separately retained paid observations open.

## Proof-critical step

From the actual 112-port source and 96 stage-one ordinary routes, construct

```
h_k = (48 I - B1* B1) B0* e_k,  k=0,...,7.
```

The full group-ring computation gives `B1 h_k=0`; the identity coefficient of `B0 h_k` is `2112 e_k`. The written proof uses the exact ordinary Gram `48I`, squared column norms four and distinct stage-one routes. Payload-constant fields preserve the arbitrary regular-cover action, so the witness applies at every positive tensor size.

Prescribe the post-G state `X'_U=Y'_U=h`, `X'_A=P_(2,A)B2h`, `Y'_A=-X'_A`, `X'_T=Y'_T=0`. Surjectivity gives a preimage for **every** admitted G. Its fixed U/T equations force `f=0`, `X_U=h` and the original normalized selected sum `a+c=-B0h != 0`. At least one original selected input is therefore nonzero. Fixed B1 erases all selected values and leaves only `Y_0,U=h`; the credited tail then has zero allowed observations. Zero input has those same observations. No decoder of them alone can restore both inputs.

The proof quantifies over the encoder family; finite examples are regressions, not an inference of an unbounded result. It does not assert that the original T alone remains nonzero for every changed logger.

## Accounting and limits

The pinned original local F0/B1 pair has native mass **11076**, real scalar bound **426196**, **528** added full-cover maps and **64** wrapper maps. These are contextual local counts, not a full controller bill or a lower bound for a resynthesized G; map counts are not physical address costs.

The favorable completed screen grants the **entire changed G zero cost**, including internal reads, frames, hosting, routing, precision and restoration, while retaining exact endpoint/observation obligations. Information loss already makes this relaxation infeasible. No moment-root claim or native synthesis is warranted.

Not claimed: an obstruction to arbitrary changed first pairs, a lower bound on paid reads, global native execution, complete cold replay, all-size supplier admission, stronger κ, formal-kernel verification or hosted-CI success. title: Prove a conditional cutoff-independent bootstrap time bound
body:
## Result and precise claim

This proves a **conditional, cutoff-independent uniform time lifting lemma** for the H2 obligation left explicit by [PR1965](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1965) and [PR1990](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1990). For the native first ordinary-bootstrap stage in the selected PR1094 assembly, it supplies

```text
T(e)/V <= K [e^(1-s) + e^(1-a') + e^s(1+log2 e) + w^(1-a)]
K = C * max(401501, 2*sigma)
a'=(1-s)s+s*a,  w=ceil(e^s),  a=384599/10^10.
```

This holds at every integer radix width e >= 1 with an integer borrowed width 0 <= k < e/2 and k <= ceil(sigma*w*(1+log2 e)), **provided the explicit uniform primitive/endpoint contracts in the proof hold and their seven time coefficients are at most C**. C and sigma are not measured or asserted to satisfy a numerical allowance. There is no new kappa, changed cutoff, supplier adoption, or complete multiplication theorem.

Package: [`research/selected-bootstrap-uniform-time`](https://github.com/adamgall/integer-mult-bounds/tree/research/contribution-20261014-04/research/selected-bootstrap-uniform-time).

## What is new relative to the predecessors

Josie Elliston's PR1956 identified the carried-time-constant issue; PR1965 separates time absorption from stock fit but explicitly assumes that its H2 estimate holds whenever the stock fits. ToikY's PR1990 independently checks stock-fit arithmetic and retains this uniformity obligation. This contribution expands that implication into a quantified recurrence, a completely charged wrapper bill, and a source-bound rational K. It does **not** repeat their fourteen headrooms, compute the H3 stock coefficient, or import the historical m=120 reserve constant.

The implication remains conditional on real uniform primitives; an eventual big-O statement alone is insufficient. A finite leaf-cost spike provides an exact negative control for that distinction.

## Proof and complete bill

For nonnegative recursive coefficients c_r, 1 <= r < m, suppose uniformly in integer n,w:

```text
T(0,w)=0
T(n,w)<=Cleaf*w^(1-a)                         (1<=n<m)
T(n,w)<=sum c_r*T(r*floor(n/m),w)
         +Cadapt*n+Cpeel*w^(1-a)              (n>=m).
```

With positive lower bounds g1,gt on the linear and stopped moment gaps, induction gives
`T(n,w)<=A*n+B*n^(1-s)*w^(1-a)`, where `A=Cadapt/g1` and `B=max(Cleaf,Cpeel/gt)`.

The full normalized wrapper bill is

```text
(4A+6Cshift)n + 4B*n^(1-s)*w^(1-a)
  + Cpad + Crem*w^(1-a) + Chi*k^(1-a),
n=floor((e-k)/w).
```

The factor four pays two reversed body calls on less than twice the original padded volume; six pays three shifts on that volume. Padding scans, residual digits and the completed high-part exchange are explicit. Row restoration is required before restricting to genuine rows. The two calls occur outside recursion and do not multiply the recursive moment.

Using `n<=e/w`, `e^s<=w<=2e^s`, `0<=a<=s<1` and `k^(1-a)<=k` for integer k>=1 gives

```text
K=max(4A+6Cshift+Cpad+Chi, 8B, 2sigma*Chi, Crem).
```

The proof retains the stock ceiling's extra one and handles an empty atom body. There is no cutoff L in K.

For generated descriptor work bounded per prefix by `Cdesc*e^d*w^b`, a complete q^w target fiber gives, with `D=b+ceil(d/s)`, the all-width bound
`Cdesc*e^d*w^b/q^w <= Cdesc*2^D*D!`.
The exact positive generating-series proof removes a merely asymptotic preparation threshold, but still requires a uniform degree/site-count bound. Incomplete fibers cannot use this estimate.

## Selected source binding

The native selected first stage uses PR589's **BIT m=64**, W=28416, maximum child 42, not the complex m=73 producer. The selected receipt's existing surcharged moment certificate at `bit_lower` is authenticated and reused; no new root calculation or independent supplier replay is claimed.

The frozen PR1087 assembler supplies
`s=min(bit_lower,(1-10^-24)*complex_lower)-10^-27` and the complete rank-one fallback surcharge. Exact arithmetic gives

```text
g1 = 16326904278023 / 2890625000000000
gt = (11/32)*(bit_lower-s)
4/g1+8 < 717
8/gt < 401501.
```

The gt inequality follows from concavity: for d=bit_lower-s in (0,1) and x<=42/64,
`x^d<=1-d*(1-x)<=1-(11/32)d`. Multiplication into the inherited positive moment terms proves the stated sufficient gap without calculating another moment root. These inequalities give `K=C*max(401501,2sigma)`.

Exact Git blob/SHA256 pins, the archive member hash, original selection, task scope and canonical result are included. Archived predecessor Python is authenticated and read, never executed.

## Actual validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only:

```text
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/selected-bootstrap-uniform-time/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bootstrap-uniform-time
```

The final scientific smoke and registered normal/`-O` replays passed:

- 6,156 independent explicit-recursion-tree versus dynamic-programming and induction cases;
- 539 exact complete-wrapper bill cases, including floor/residual boundaries;
- 1,664 descriptor inequalities and 1,458 literal padded complete endpoints;
- 16 mathematical countermodel/semantic/source controls, including omitted charges, missing padding, lost row restoration, incomplete fibers, eventual-versus-uniform leaf cost, changed selected profile/surcharge, non-strict inherited receipt and source/member drift. The padding, incomplete-fiber and finite-spike cases are countermodels to weakened premises, not reports of selected implementation bugs.

Outputs include `PASS_SELECTED_BOOTSTRAP_UNIFORM_TIME` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. All acceptance uses exact arithmetic and explicit checks, not Python assertions. The universal claim rests on the written proof, not these finite fixtures. No full selected cold replay, Lean run or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

## Provenance, overlap and limits

Scientific base: `564148b82ae9df72163f22106f15e73efca8aff2`, priority revision 4. Independent selection seed: `3c6ed534c7c882d069b0dc2c8cd99397`, adversarial-audit, emitted `uniform-transfer-audit` card refined to this H2 implication. Contribution commit: `b5ffc48e3dd5c92f591bdb4fabafa2c8e8b33970`.

The later canonical checkpoint `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` changes guidance only; catalogue, selected record and scientific inputs remain unchanged. Retained PR1965 head `c9819a94f9c630f8b42ff5c3027965c4ba451653` and PR1990 head `c3bd90d9a8d9202c063700ae443e83825780e056` are now merged; their exact source statements and live dispositions were read. The submission overlap search at 19:03:36Z used complete cached snapshots of 353 open PRs (19:00:33Z) and 738 discussion/comment/reply records (19:02:09Z), plus 1,538 local records. Relevant retained sources and three historical circuit/recurrence matches were inspected. Freshness and coverage limits are recorded in TASK.json; these non-atomic cached text searches are not a novelty certificate and do not cover every diff or unpublished work.

**Remaining obligations:** bind actual primitive implementations to the uniform coefficients and preparation-site counts; derive the actual same-domain sigma; preserve all inherited endpoint, compiler, normalized logical-volume, tape and analytic contracts. Later bootstrap stages require their preceding completed ordinary contract. This package binds native stage one only and does not silently adopt H2 for a real implementation.

The first useful continuation is to source-bind logical-volume normalization, fixed-tape parking and descriptor preparation to the named uniform coefficients. Separately, derive the selected BIT cover divisor/depth stock envelope for H3. The README and TASK.json state the blockers and first steps.

title: Realize two mutable snapshots with selected physical address maps
body:
## Research claim

This realizes the fixed PR1704 two-copy scatter in PR1627's **selected PR589 exact physical-stream model**. This is a new physical boundary implication for that concrete bit-helper mechanism, **not** a new scalar optimization, admitted compiler/supplier, κ improvement, or formal-kernel theorem. The selected κ remains 0.001672660197076918.

## Predecessors and changed premise

- Ross Richardson's **#1704**, head `7f14aa7285cf10a7be350472fab25a25ef898484`: fixed pair partition `(0,3),(1),(2,4),(5,7),(6,8)`, 120-ADD saving, scalar restoration and accounting. Those results are credited, not reclaimed.

For frame projector P, `D_P(x,y)=((I-P)x+Py,Px+(I-P)y)`. The two copied values are their distinct centers composed with their own `D_P`; they are never identified merely because ranks agree.

The checker independently reconstructs all636 rational frame projectors, authenticates exact source bytes, multiplies exact rational address maps into the function atoms at every MOVE, and checks every COPY/ERASE chronological transport in both complete local orientations. title: Sharp eight-query temporal cut for the frozen P104 itinerary
body:
## Result

This adds `research/p104-temporal-query-cut/`: a sharp temporal communication obstruction for the complete frozen P104 itinerary of PR1972/PR1991.

Even permitting arbitrary additional or replacement **common-frame linear role mixing at every one of the 4,059 cuts**, while retaining the original transports and private-storage lifetimes, the source-to-target transfer has rank at most **eight arrays**. The original dirty-restored `G/2` channel attains that rank. Therefore no zero-new-transport correction in this domain can complete it to the 104-port identity.

This does **not** exclude the separately proposed terminal `+208 H1` correction, new or retimed transports, new storage lifetimes, or non-common-chart native operations. It supplies no new supplier or kappa. The 96 missing array directions are **not** a 96-child native lower bound.

## Method and proof-critical step

The checker authenticates the exact source witness, reconstructs frames by literal binary XOR closure, and saturates each equal-frame class at every cut. Thus it includes all permitted additional scalar edges, not just the original ADD list or equal-rank registers. It includes all 72 dirty helpers and eight owned-private-copy lifetimes.

At cut 2429, after events 0–2428 and before the first D-helper transport:

- the forward source cone is all 104 X registers, 32 G helpers and eight Q queries;
- the backward target cone is all 104 Y registers, 32 D helpers and eight Q queries;
- their intersection is precisely Q0,…,Q7.

Deleting those eight wire crossings disconnects every X input from every final Y output, including possible later full-frame-helper routes. For a finite address space of dimension d, every admitted linear X→Y block therefore factors through eight d-dimensional query values and has rank at most 8d. Identity completion requires rank 104d. A query's rank-eight **frame** is not eight arrays: wire dimension and native child rank are kept separate.

The written argument covers arbitrary finite linear programs in this fixed-itinerary model; it does not generalize a finite coefficient search.

## Exact evidence

The reproducible certificate reports:

- 4,058 original events, all 4,059 cuts, 444 exact frame subspaces;
- 106,254,468 implicit directed common-frame edges with chronological multiplicity;
- both directional causal scans and a separate cut-deletion scan;
- all 280 arbitrary logical input columns, all 72 dirty helpers and sources restored by the attaining original word;
- an exact `G/2` principal minor on ports `[0,1,2,3,7,14,22,33]` with determinant **1/256**, proving rank-eight attainment;
- `R^t R = 26 I`, `G² = 26G`, and `(I-G/2)^(-1) = I-G/24`, showing the residual has rank 104;
- eleven semantic negative controls and one positive basis-invariance control.

The negative controls leave each query out of the separator in turn, introduce a prohibited cross-frame bypass, or remove initial dirty-query compensation / final query cleanup. The graph controls reopen genuine source-target paths; the scalar controls reject the arbitrary-input endpoint. Every mathematical field is regenerated and compared canonically with `RESULT.json`.

## Complete favorable budget and limitations

The unchanged local profile is `{1:1074,2:58,3:86,4:104,5:48,6:24,7:8,8:8}`, with mass **2368 = 2312 boundary coverage + COPY56**, 2,624 scalar additions and eight allocate/copy/discard lifetimes. The tested completion adds zero transports, copies or lifetimes, and generously treats additional scalar mixing, hosting, idle remainder and precision cost as free. It still fails the exact communication condition before a recursive moment comparison is meaningful.

No global owner assignment, native phase recompilation, all-size lifting, precision theorem, outer multiplication theorem or formal-kernel proof is claimed. Inherited PR1991 native identities are explicitly distinguished from the independently replayed logical/frame facts.

title: Exhibit a QQ16 kernel invisible to nonzero-chart source queries
body:
## Research claim

For the actual QQ16 first `F0/B1` pair and retained ordinary schedule, adding the exact pre-`F0` ordinary-to-selected record `B2 X_U` still does **not** determine the original selected A input. This package gives an explicit three-port counterexample with

```
B1 h = B2 h = 0,   B0 h != 0.
```

The same input is invisible to every nonzero-chart query `B_s`, `1 <= s <= 8`. All selected endpoints, all completed-X descendants and all five forward-query histories also agree with the zero input. Hence even an arbitrary final decoder cannot recover the required A input from that expanded observation set.

This is a scoped exact obstruction, not a search failure, new supplier, or exponent improvement. It leaves changed first pairs, old-chart reads, other observations and their physical pricing open.

## Predecessors and changed premise

- Ali Romman's merged [PR1969](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1969) supplies the actual QQ16 maps, owner routes, native contracts and prior selected-observation witness. Its independent review already proves eight lost directions with `B1 h=0` and `B2 h!=0`; that result is **not** repeated as new.
- Cinna Davis's [PR2079](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2079), inspected at immutable head `49df8190b158e3028e702b2c6b798117006f7249`, adds `B2 X_U` and proves it separates those eight directions. It explicitly leaves full-controller injectivity open. This contribution answers that open question for the fixed first pair by supplying a different kernel, losing initial A rather than the prior initial T. It does not contradict PR2079's bounded separation claim.
- The gauge44/t16 source notices retain icekylinx, chafreaky and the earlier supplier lineage. No frozen predecessor or selected record is changed.

## Exact construction and proof-critical step

The operation-derived query columns satisfy `r_2=r_8+r_85`. The actual first local chart axes at those ports have binary masks `37,38,506`. For owner `d`, let `f_v(d)=bit_0(d v)` as an integer bit and set

```
h_2(d)=-f_37(d),   h_8(d)=f_38(d),   h_85(d)=f_506(d),
h_p(d)=0 otherwise.
```

The actual owner involution sends each port's first local axis to the same stage axis:

```
rho_s(p) b_(p,0) = e_(9+8(s-1)),   1 <= s <= 8.
```

Therefore `B_s h=(-r_2+r_8+r_85) f_(e_stage)=0` at **every owner**, while `B0 h(I)=-r_2 != 0`. The functions are constant only in payload coordinates, not in owner coordinates. Native payload translations and endpoint line operators fix them.

Set pair zero to

```
X_U=h, Y_U=0,
X_A=-P_(0,A)B0h, Y_A=-X_A,
X_T=Y_T=0,
```

and all other banks to zero. The original A input at the identity owner is
`(1/2,0,1/2,1/2,0,-1/2,0,0)`. The exact ordered `F0` has zero query and leaves `X_U=Y_U=h` with zero selected state. Then `q2=B2h=0` and `b1=B1h=0`, so `B1` leaves only `Y_0,U=h`. The added pre-read is also zero.

The source-template tail puts `-h` into `Y_1,U`, removes it around the zero-source `F2`, and leaves every later active pair zero. All five forward histories vanish. Arbitrary later homogeneous selected-only controls preserve the zero selected state. The terminal exchange moves h to **named final X0 with the old-Y native type**, not a completed-X descendant; all permitted observations remain zero.

The README provides the full all-owner proof. This is not inferred from a finite sample of owners.

## Cost boundary and stop decision

Grant B2 extraction, all eight output coordinates, source/address/frame access, storage, restoration, endpoint conversion, chronological hosting and precision **zero additional cost**. Even this maximally favorable complete observation budget fails recovery. More payment for the same observation cannot remove the kernel.

For orientation only, the retained F/B native masses are 5530/5546 (11076 for the first pair); a hypothetical separately charged rank-8 record would give 11084 before other charges. No native implementation of that record or completed recursive moment is claimed. Feedback that changes the first pair is outside this audit.

## Artifact, provenance and reproducibility

Package: `research/qq16-b2-observation-kernel/`.

- Scientific base: `564148b82ae9df72163f22106f15e73efca8aff2`.
- Latest guidance checkpoint: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; priority revision 4, scientific inputs and selected record unchanged.
- Single chooser seed: `20e7cbb51ab8b49eac12de2f825e100a`, track `independent-verification`; complete output retained in `SELECTION.json`.
- Selected-record SHA256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- Exact live-input Git blobs/SHA256 pins: `SOURCES.json`; exact archive members and canonical observation receipt: `RESULT.json`.
- The complete overlap snapshot at `2026-10-14T19:02:09Z` covered 353 open PRs including drafts, 738 discussion/comment/reply records, and 1536 local records. PR2079's body, immutable proof and current head were checked directly. This is not a guarantee of absence or novelty.

The standard-library verifier authenticates source bytes before parsing, imports no predecessor Python, independently reconstructs R from original scalar operations and owner routes from the phase axes, executes the ordered maps on exact sparse functions, and replays the original hosted-template schedule. Regeneration compares the **complete canonical result**, not compression headers.

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/qq16-b2-observation-kernel/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-b2-observation-kernel
```

Observed final output:

```
PASS_QQ16_B2_OBSERVATION_KERNEL
3 ordinary ports; B1h=B2h=0; original A nonzero; 8 zero observations; 8 rejecting controls
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/qq16-b2-observation-kernel outcome=negative-result
```

The eight controls reject a changed dependency coefficient, changed chart axis, omitted A cancellation, missing negative bridge, old-Y/completed-X type confusion, replacement by a detecting B0 observation, payload-only routing and source-byte mutation. The required selected-baseline binding-only working example also passed. No full selected cold replay, proof-assistant run, human review or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

## Open next questions

1. Does adding B0 together with B2 and retained observations recover the **whole** fixed-pair kernel? First derive the full ordered kernel; the B0 positive escape control here proves only that it detects this witness. Actual native access and complete pricing remain open.
2. Can a changed first pair preserve both old-chart components cheaply? Establish its arbitrary-input identity and full output/hosting/restoration invoice before synthesis.

title: Prove the native P104 channel's all-cut precision interface
body:
## Result and research claim

This supplies a **finite local precision interface** for the actual native P104 `G/2` channel of [PR1991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1991), not a new channel compilation, side correction or supplier. The domain is the immutable 4,058-event word: 104 sources, 104 targets, 72 arbitrary dirty helpers and eight distinct owned private-copy lifetimes.

The norm is the maximum of individual register **Hilbert norms**, not an addresswise maximum or a concatenated all-register norm. If each independent input has norm at most `B`, exact signed propagation gives:

| Quantity | Exact coefficient |
|---|---:|
| Maximum ideal input-to-prefix row norm | **106** (the ideal endpoint maximum is only 26) |
| All-cut accumulation of independent unit absolute defects at every update | **450** |
| All-cut weighted accumulation, with addition weight `1+abs(a)` and other update weights 1 | **668** |
| Native-child-only all-cut accumulation | **356**, versus final all-role coefficient **336** |

The absolute-defect statement is sharp for independent arbitrary additive vector defects. There are 4,042 defect sites: 1,410 native transports, 2,624 scalar additions and eight copies. Exact-zero allocation, exact monomial factors and owned discard are explicit premises. Final all-defect coefficients are 7 for sources, 1153/4 for targets and 450 for dirty helpers. Discarding a private copy does not erase errors already propagated to other registers.

For state-relative local defects bounded by `u` times the actual input norm at a native transport/copy, or `u*(||dst||+abs(a)*||src||)` at an addition, the complete all-cut feedback implication is

```
668*u < 1
M <= 106*B/(1-668*u)
max_boundary_error <= 106*668*u*B/(1-668*u).
```

Thus **`u <= 2^(-b-17)` suffices** for all-role error at most `B*2^-b`, for every integer `b>=0`. The feedback estimate is sufficient, not an attained rounding error or a minimal-precision claim. In particular, neither endpoint-only accuracy nor exact symbolic dirty restoration can replace all-cut stability.

## Proof-critical native binding and method

The retained primitive is `C_q=((1+i)I+(1-i)X_q)/2`, with eigenvalues `1` and `i` on the two eigenspaces of the involutive permutation `X_q`. Its inverse and every address-permutation/Gaussian-phase factor are unitary. The replay authenticates source bytes **before importing** the retained independent interpreter, then checks all **740 transport recipes / 1,410 occurrences**, **208 monomial endpoint adapters** and **948 exact normalized Gaussian columns**, including signed Pauli actions and scalar phases. It does not assume an unspecified recursive child is contractive.

A physical defect after an instruction is conjugated by that instruction's actual unitary canonical frame. Its Hilbert norm is unchanged, leaving the exact literal scalar recurrence. Forward input/error-symbol rows cover every instruction boundary; a separate reverse-adjoint recurrence agrees on all **62,867 nonzero signed endpoint-response coefficients** and the entire arbitrary-input map. Sign-aligned constructive executions attain 106, 450 and the independent weighted-defect coefficient 668. Exact native controls distinguish Hilbert from pointwise norms and show that norm bounds alone cannot authenticate global phase.

## Accounting and limitations

The word and paid profile are unchanged:

`1074 H1 + 58 H2 + 86 H3 + 104 H4 + 48 H5 + 24 H6 + 8 H7 + 8 H8`, rank mass **2368 = 2312 boundary coverage + COPY56**.

No precision reserve or recursive charge is removed. The abstract argument applies to the same scalar word with unitary charts in any Hilbert dimension, but only the concrete nine-coordinate/512-address native realization is source-checked. This does **not** establish actual rounded-child error bounds, internal recursive-kernel stability, the `I-G/2` correction, chronological global owner hosting, tape/all-size admission, a completed supplier moment or a new κ. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are untouched.

## Evidence and reproduction

Eight files, all under `research/p104-native-precision/`, including proof, full selection/task/source/replay metadata, exact receipt and semantic tests.

```text
PASS_P104_NATIVE_PRECISION_TESTS dense_defects=4042 independent_impulses=18 source_drift=reject read_only_optimized_export=pass

```

## Provenance, predecessors and scope change

title: Audit fresh-row conditioning in the selected stopped cover
body:
## Result and scope

This adds `research/selected-cover-fresh-fibers/`: a **conditional all-depth address/counting theorem** for the selected stopped bit cover, with exact adversarial controls. No new κ, supplier, numerical stock coefficient, or full all-size compiler admission is claimed.

A stock bound and a restored row endpoint do not alone justify the selected producer's per-edge bad-class average. The missing interface is that each invocation sees complete fresh row fibers, conditional on its ancestors. The package proves that implication from the source's field-dependency and complete-execution contract, and explicitly leaves the selected compiler's implementation of that contract conditional.

### The theorem

For any integers `W>=2`, finite depth `D>=1`, and genuine row range `Q>=S=W^D`, pad once to `P=ceil(Q/S)*S`. Euclidean division identifies `[P]` with `[ceil(Q/S)] × [W]^D`.

Assume at every invocation boundary:

- invocation existence, width, fixed edge list and weights depend only on ancestor fields and fixed program indices;
- current-role routing is a bijection depending only on ancestors, fixing ancestors and unused descendant stock;
- a completed child restores its supplied row field and ancestor spectators before sequential reuse;
- execution uses the entire padded range, restricting to genuine rows only at the completed row-restoring endpoint.

Then every live invocation domain is a union of complete suffix cylinders. For each fixed ancestor prefix, every current role has exactly the same number of unused-stock completions. Prefix-dependent stopping and fallback are allowed: a parent's current residue becomes a child's ancestor. The proof is induction on invocation depth, not a finite-experiment generalization. There is exactly one volume factor `P/Q<2`, not one per recursive call. Endpoint restoration justifies unpadding; it does not justify pruning intermediate invocation domains.

### Selected binding and unchanged paid bill

The frozen PR1087 assembler binds the selected PR589 record by Git blob `e293ddc557742637f9f679f083a1a282d87b1b13` and SHA256. The actual ordinary producer has `m=64`, 28,416 live roles, 28,425 physical roles, 904,896 paid edge occurrences and maximum child rank 42. Dimension 73 belongs to the complex supplier and is not substituted into this bit argument.

For the selected role divisor

`W(w) = 28425 * |GL_64(Z/q^w Z)|`,

every invertible low matrix has exactly `q^(4096*(w-1))` lifts. Right multiplication preserves these equal fibers. Fix an eligible odd prime `q>2^80` before input widths, avoiding the fixed rational denominators and rank witnesses, as required by the inherited source contract. Its per-edge bad fraction is then bounded by `2*64^3/q < 10^-16` at every fresh invocation. Summing costs over fixed edge occurrences needs no independence assumption and no simultaneous union bound.

With selected histogram `H`, `E=sum H_r=904896` and `L=28416`, the complete retained bill remains

```
(1/L) sum_r H_r*(r/64)^(1-a)
  + (1/10^16)*(32*64^2)*E/L*(1/64)^(1-a).
```

All good terms and the full fallback stay charged. There is no root refinement, displaced-good subtraction, or claimed change to selected κ.

### Exact counterexamples

1. **Adaptive current-role edge selection:** in `GL_2(F_q)`, index predicates by projective lines `[v]` and let `B_v={g:first_row(g)·v=0}`. Every fixed edge is bad on exactly `1/(q+1)` of the group. Choosing the kernel line of the current first row makes the chosen edge bad everywhere. Identity routing and final row restoration remain valid. The only removed hypothesis is that the edge choice be fixed before reading that invocation's current role. This is a linear-minor witness, not an arbitrary rare-set oracle.
2. **Pruning dummy rows:** `W=3,D=2,Q=10` requires padded range `P=18`. At prefix `(slab,current)=(1,0)`, the genuine prefix contains only fresh value 0, whereas the padded execution contains all three values. Conditional frequency changes from `1/3` to 1 even with identity routes and exact endpoint restoration.

These expose invalid generalizations of the averaging argument, **not a demonstrated defect in the selected compiler**.

## Sources, predecessors and novelty boundary

The README maps every theorem hypothesis to exact pinned sections of `three-stage-cover-bit.tex`, `three-stage-cover-rows.tex`, the retained PR185 proof, the selected PR589 record and frozen PR1087 assembler. The old dimension-67 note supplies a structural contract, not a selected numerical profile. Portability to the selected implementation stays conditional; finite scalar/controller records do not themselves emit an all-size read/write certificate.

Josie Elliston's [#1956](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1956)/[#1965](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1965) and ToikY's [#1990](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1990) isolate cutoff and stock-fit obligations. This contribution addresses the **fresh-field/counting implication**, not their headroom arithmetic. `r480-sharp-charge535` and its PR461/464/465 predecessors already sharpen the numerical bad-class allowance; that refinement is not claimed here.

The finite source bytes and archived assembler member are authenticated before parsing; predecessor Python is never imported or executed. Selected frontier files, frozen evidence, shared indices and existing packages are unchanged.

## Evidence and reproduction

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/selected-cover-fresh-fibers/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-cover-fresh-fibers
```

Observed smoke and registered optimized (`-I -O`) replay:

```
PASS_SELECTED_COVER_FRESH_FIBERS cases=60 cuts=150 GL_rings=4 controls=9
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-cover-fresh-fibers outcome=completed
```

Coverage: 14,120 padded rows, 2,370 conditional fibers, four full `GL_2` enumerations over moduli 3, 9, 5 and 25, adaptive-minor witnesses at primes 3, 5 and 7, and nine rejected semantic/source mutations. `RESULT.json` is required and compared canonically with fresh reconstruction. Assertions are not the acceptance gate. Separate code/proof review and registered replay corroborated the result; final review edits clarified prime eligibility and removed a redundant tautological check without changing the scientific receipt.

The first registration attempt rejected a non-enumerated metadata outcome; it was corrected to `completed`, and the registered replay above passed. No full selected supplier cold replay, formal-kernel check, hosted CI pass or independent human review is claimed.

## Provenance and overlap

- Scientific base: `564148b82ae9df72163f22106f15e73efca8aff2`.
- Submitted head: `1d3ee0926656d5260c6cb1c0b81964ffe9fe1377`.
- Original selection: seed `cc5bf62436a3476502c7769e29c2990c`, adversarial-audit, priority revision 4; complete output in `SELECTION.json`, no redraw.
- Card scope changed from numerical `selected-stock-envelope` work to its explicit field-independence implication; the reason and stop condition are in `TASK.json`.
- Upstream checkpoint `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` changed guidance only; selected record, catalogue and scientific inputs are unchanged.
- Shared refresh: 353 open PRs including drafts at 19:00:33 UTC and 738 discussion/comment/reply records at 19:02:09 UTC, complete pagination. Targeted offline/local search at 19:09:29 UTC and direct live PR1990 disposition reading are recorded. Cached coverage can miss changes; no absence-based novelty guarantee is asserted.

## Remaining question and credit

The concrete next step is an emitted all-size field-dependency certificate: verify that each call guard/edge-list/weight reads only ancestors and each route fixes unused descendant fields. Start with the retained child-weight rule and current chart routing, then annotate the selected all-size lowering. Stock magnitude or scalar endpoint restoration cannot substitute for this obligation. A deliberately current-residue-adaptive selector would instead need its own fully paid fiberwise charge.

Credit to the retained three-stage-cover framework and eumemic's source527 packaging; Rohan Arun's PR185/PR387 and selected PR1094 lineage; Jeremy Kothe's PR1087 assembler; PR589's credited punctured-E8, nine-stage and hosting lineage; and the named cutoff and numerical-charge predecessors. Prepared for Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in investigation, proof, code and writing. Apache-2.0. No predecessor result is claimed as new.

title: Heterogeneous 3+7 order-four boundary across two distinct source banks
body:
## Scope

`recursive-interfaces`, card `persistent-boundary` (scope key `026be4b6e61971d51838`), chooser OS nonce `ba18ac446df7d55ddc50d91395fd9a57`, priority revision 3. Base `e112d71c8d7bb32435debcc54df932593dd8223a`, branch `research/agent-38-persistent-boundary-ba18ac44`. Package: `research/z4-hetero-two-bank-seedba18/`.

Card selection note (pair-collision): the first-choice card `centre-path-sharing` matches already-claimed recent objects (centre-sharing claims in https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166 at 12:58 and 13:03 UTC on 2026-10-14), so the second-choice card `persistent-boundary` was taken. This is recorded in `TASK.json`.

**Object.** The one uncovered cell of the pinned PR1391 order-four typed boundary interface: two consecutive root echoes with heterogeneous reader schedules across **two distinct source banks**. Type A has three children reading source octets `[0,1,2]` of bank `X`; type B has seven children reading `[2,1,0,2,1,0,2]` of bank `Y`; one arbitrary dirty output octet and one 24-coordinate arbitrary dirty workspace must both be restored exactly. Predecessors cover 5|5 identical calls on two banks with a midpoint handoff (`research/z4-distinct-source-seed55`) and heterogeneous 3|7 calls on one shared source (`research/z4-heterogeneous-pair-seed3x7`, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1768); neither covers this cell, where the charged 48-ADD source handoff sits at an asymmetric 3|7 boundary. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18932122

## Result

One joint ten-child phase-indexed typed echo with the handoff `W += P^t(Y-X)` after child 2 replaces the two separate calls. Exact maps pass on all 80 basis columns in both directions.

| Execution | ADD | NEG | Primitives | Reads | Prefix row-L1 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| A then B, separate | 1,552 | 144 | 1,696 | 3,248 | 18 |
| Joint, asymmetric 3-to-7 handoff | 1,408 | 144 | 1,552 | 2,960 | 21 |

Saving: **144 primitives and 288 reads** (8.5%), all costs charged (both forward and literal-inverse child bodies, per-call 48-ADD copy/restore wrappers, the 48-ADD handoff, and both traversals of every phase boundary).

**Boundary law (exact for this alphabet).** The workspace boundary charge has period 4 under the exact recurrence `F_0(t)=A(t)`, `F_(j+1)(s)=min_t F_j(t)+A((s-t-1) mod 4)`, terminal phase 0, with `A = [(0,0),(54,6),(36,12),(54,6)]`: `g(k) = g(k mod 4)`, cross-checked against exhaustive coverage at 64 + 1,024 + 16,384 + 1,048,576 phase paths (k = 3, 5, 7, 10) and for k = 1..16. Consequently `separate(k1,k2) - joint(k1,k2) = 2(g(k1)+g(k2)-g(k1+k2))`, which at total 10 is 144 primitives exactly when both child counts are odd and 0 when both are even. Both sides are confirmed by emitted words: the heterogeneous 3|7 pair realizes the full 144 (invoice identical to the 5|5 case), and a 2|8 pair with the same banks and child family passes both maps with **zero** saving.

## Evidence and reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -B research/z4-hetero-two-bank-seedba18/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/z4-hetero-two-bank-seedba18 --check-only
```

Observed (CPython 3.12, Windows):

```text
PASS_Z4_HETERO_TWO_BANK_3_7 g3=60 g7=60 g10=48 separate=1696 joint=1552 saved=144 reads_saved=288 law=odd_splits_only even28_saved=0 paths=64+1024+16384+1048576 basis=80 controls=6
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

`verify.py` re-checks the pinned PR1391/PR1410 input blobs and the selected-record hash at base, the 12 typed-child identities `Q^(-t)R_b P^t = R_b` and gate counts, recurrence-versus-exhaustive agreement, the exact 5|5 predecessor figures (positive control), the 3|7 and 2|8 exact maps and invoices, and six negative controls (midpoint-instead-of-3|7 switch, wrong handoff phase, mutated A reader, omitted B call, missing terminal Y restoration, missing literal inverse), each rejected by the exact map. `RESULT.json` must match the recomputation byte-for-byte on a second run (it does).

## Limitations and remaining obligations

- Exact only for the declared order-four phase-indexed child alphabet and these fixed reader schedules; not a lower bound for arbitrary ADD/NEG words.
- Output-row reindexing is free in this word model (it is the typed ADD target). Address calculation, physical row routing, source hosting, tape travel, fixed-precision admission, recursive assembly into a selected supplier and analytic transfer are unproved.
- The joint word raises the prefix row-L1 peak from 18 to 21; no precision improvement is claimed.
- No new κ, selected moment, supplier or frontier change. The typed interface remains outside the selected supplier chain.
- The registered package replay (`scripts/research_package.py --package research/z4-hetero-two-bank-seedba18` without `--check-only`) was not launched here; the same `verify.py` was run twice under CPython 3.12 with identical output.

## Credit

Aaron Wang, with help from opencode (substantial AI assistance; no independent human review claimed). Predecessor credit: Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337) for the order-four child family (PR #1391), the same-source persistent boundary (PR #1410), `research/z4-persistent-pair-seed57`, `research/z4-paired-frame-restoration-seed56` and `research/z4-distinct-source-seed55` (typed two-bank 5|5); 1337isnot1337 for `research/z4-heterogeneous-pair-seed3x7` (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1768). The selected-result context is Rohan Arun's https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1094 on Jeremy Kothe's #1087 construction. All predecessor inputs are pinned byte-for-byte in `inputs/` and `SOURCES.json`.

The recorded scope change and reason are in `TASK.json`.

## Established

All numbers are recomputed by `verify.py` from the pinned word file and `tune/EXPECTED.json`, with frame dimensions computed here by exact rational rank. No code is imported from the supplier's checker chain (`stage_cohort.py`, `legality_h.cpp`, `global_k.py`).

1. The 636 label frames (live line sets, closures of the 120 labelled E8 lines punctured to 111) have exact rank spectrum dim 0:1, dim 1:111, dim 2:153, dim 4:70, dim 6:180, dim 7:120, dim 8:1.
2. Per-register net frame climbs from the recorded start/final frame ids: every X slot climbs 7, every Y slot climbs 7, every helper climbs 8.

| Class | Registers | Net climb each | Mass |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| X slots | 111 | 7 | 777 |
| Y slots | 111 | 7 | 777 |
| Helpers | 439 | 8 | 3512 |
| Copy block (nine retained totals) | 9 | 7 | 63 |

5. Five semantic mutation controls are rejected: collapsing the full frame to one label; setting one register's start frame to its final frame; mutating one copy rank to 6; a one-count mutation of `local_histogram`; a one-count mutation of `nine.profile`.

It completes the explicit caller-composition handoff from [PR2040](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2040) and [PR2059](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2059), rather than repeating their comparator or invoice-subgraph audits. The new caller composes that predicate with complete output coverage, actual stage execution, exact input roles and coupled execution receipts. PR2040's Linux observation is credited, **not presented as a Linux run here**.

## Complete comparison boundary

`POLICY.json` closes the boundary at 94 JSON/gzip-JSON outputs and 11 inner logs. Both sides must have exactly the full inventory, including when byte-identical.

Before comparison, each side independently authenticates **30 raw reference edges**:

- **2 invoice edges:** both `input_sha256/fresh_invoice` links must hash the actual same-side invoice. Only those two digests are then rebound. The complete canonical invoice and both complete consumers are compared.
- **22 log edges:** both receipts contain the same eleven ordered, successful stages; their complete arrays agree within the run, including time. Every log reference hashes that run's actual log, and all eleven logs are compared byte for byte across runs.
- **6 input roles:** the independent receipt must name exactly three work inputs, two local inputs and the source owner input, with their actual hashes. Only these six exact keys become fixed role keys. No other strings/keys undergo root-prefix rewriting, and receipt paths are never followed to read files.

Only **22 fresh stage timing fields** may vary across runs. They must be present, finite, nonnegative numbers, not Booleans or strings. All **12 copied historical timing fields** remain exact. The complete outer log checks eleven ordered stage lines against the same-side times and two exact final-result lines; no blanket line/token stripping occurs.

Every other field and digest stays in the complete strict typed comparison. Duplicate keys and nonfinite JSON reject; exact Decimal comparison avoids binary64 rounding; Boolean/integer distinctions and unknown fields are retained. Generated gzip containers are compared by decompressed payload rather than compression headers. Diagnostic classification counts are not acceptance conditions.

**Critical implication:** authenticating raw links alone does not establish semantic equality. The entire invoice is compared, so changing it and repairing both links still rejects. Likewise, changing an inner log and repairing both stage references still rejects. The finite controls exercise both cases.

An exploratory census found 173 hash-valued leaves matching output bytes, including semantic hashes and multiple byte-identical candidate targets. The caller does **not** infer roles from hash coincidence, normalize those other digests, or claim arbitrary reserialized-DAG admission. title: Quantify QQ16 information loss after the extra B2 query
body:
This adds an independent **quantitative** bound on QQ16 information loss after the proposed extra B2 query: at least `ceil(32|G|/7)` original A-input directions remain hidden, at least **four sevenths** of the entire `8|G|`-dimensional A space. No new kappa is claimed.

The final overlap refresh found Adam Gall's concurrent [PR #2093](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2093), head `8b21a900eb520e4f11ea177b310f66316f8e8983`, which already proves qualitative insufficiency with an explicit three-port witness invisible to every nonzero chart. We credit that result. This package contributes the large missing-dimension bound for the B2-only repair and a code-disjoint trace-based verification method; it does **not** extend that dimension bound to all eight nonzero-chart observations. PR2093's pinned proof was inspected; its executable was not imported or rerun.

Adding the complete pre-F0 ordinary query `B2 X_U` does not make the fixed QQ16 controller able to restore every original selected input. This follows Cinna Davis's PR #2079, which correctly separates the old eight-direction witness family and leaves full recoverability open. The new source-bound rank argument supplies a residual family in `ker B1 intersect ker B2` with nonzero `B0 h`.

For the actual three query operators on finite regular cover G, the checked traces are `tr K=1152|G|` and `tr K^2=64512|G|`. Thus `rank[B0;B1;B2]>=144|G|/7` and the missing A-input space has dimension at least `ceil(32|G|/7)`. A written ordered F0/B1 proof maps the new family to the predecessor's erased-selected state. All retained observations, including the added query, vanish although the original A value is nonzero.

The favorable screen grants the entire read-only query and its retention for free. It still fails the restoration obligation, so there is no proposed native implementation or moment gain. This dimension is not a paid recursive-child rank.

### Scope and evidence

Only `research/qq16-extra-query-residual/` is added. The fixed local pair, ordinary tail, native endpoint interpretation and stated observation cuts are retained. - Code-disjoint oracle: backward scalar covectors on all 712 input positions and orthonormal axis swaps. Full R/U96-route hashes, all three 192I coefficient matrices and both moments agree.
- Fixed receipts, explicit C3xC3 illustrative residual witness, six behavioral groups, source drift and typed/trace-preserving corruption checks. Removing actual oracle guards makes their controls fail. Normal and optimized package relocation preserve evidence.

title: Prove a two-register cost bound for three scalar mixing blocks
body:
An m=3 two-register circuit with five rank-one calls must use at least four nonmonomial scalar mixing blocks, counting terminal scalar cleanup. I prove this by reducing any two-register group-algebra word with at most three such blocks to separate unary routes without increasing a subadditive unary bill. The proof allows arbitrary noncommuting unary maps and arbitrary invertible scalar coefficients.

The package includes the all-group proof, a tensor-power justification, and exact controls. The Python 3.12 registered replay passes 692,064 S3 middle-layer cases over F2/F3/F5, noncommuting reductions, coefficient-rank failure controls, a four-block positive loop, and tensor-separation checks. Metadata and source pins pass.

I credit eumemic's PR288 model and window constraints, littleBro's PR680 coefficient-rank/partial-matching method, and the neighboring PR705/800/836 scopes. I started from canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` and read priority revision 4. The final live overlap refresh at 19:28:41 UTC covered 371 open PRs, 762 Discussion records and 1,538 local records with complete pagination and no warnings. I checked the remaining scalar-cost match and found a different cost model.

The theorem leaves four or more mixing blocks, extra-register contracts and the full five-call question open. It provides no cheaper supplier or exponent improvement and changes no selected or frozen artifact.

title: Prove the odd-denominator mW call floor with arbitrary auxiliaries
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds a uniform rank-one call bound for the full address lattice `q^-1 M_m(Z)` with fixed odd `q`. If each cleared data target `q C_i mod 2` is invertible, then any word using `k` paid rank-one calls satisfies `k >= mW`, even with arbitrarily many dirty auxiliary registers and free interleaved `GL_n(F2)` mixing. The column decomposition gives a matching `mW`-call construction. The proof also covers the data-to-data endpoint condition when auxiliary output blocks are unconstrained.

For `m=W=3`, the package gives an exact nine-call word for `C1=I`, `C2=I+E21`, `C3=I+E32`. The new mechanism is a square-zero augmentation of the formal additive group algebra; each call contributes a matrix of rank at most one on register-address space, while the data block has rank nine. It permits arbitrary rational relations among frames. This is a scoped algebraic result, not a supplier implementation or a `kappa` improvement. Even-denominator frames and targets singular after clearing are outside the bound.

## Task and overlap

- Track/task: `bit-mechanisms` / `bit-new-register-model`; seed `16c9467a282673c96099aae5db2415a9`; priority revision 4; refined scope.
- Exact base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`; catalogue and predecessor pins are in `SOURCES.json`.
- This extends the arbitrary-register one-relation lemma to unrestricted relation rank under the odd-lattice hypothesis, and extends dirty-auxiliary coverage from two active roles to arbitrary `W`. PR #1974 uses the finite `F2[GL3(F2)]` label group, and PR #2027 uses `UT4(F2)`; neither is this rational additive lattice. Current S3/finite-GL3 claims (#2012 and #2102) use different address groups; the four-role rational-frame claim #2091 includes a half-integral frame and lies outside this odd-denominator premise.
- Original claim: [Discussion #1167 comment 18932466](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18932466).

## Validation

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-odd-denominator-register-floor-seed16c946/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-odd-denominator-register-floor-seed16c946 --check-only
```

The exact formal replay passed on CPython 3.14.7. It checks the nine-call word with 0, 1, and 3 auxiliaries; source hashes; the rank-nine target block; odd-lattice additivity; rank-one projector and mixer controls; and deleted-call, mutated-frame, wrong-endpoint, even-determinant, and even-denominator controls. Package metadata and source pins pass. The registered replay requires Python 3.12, which is unavailable on this host, so the repository package runner was not executed locally; `--check-only` validates metadata and pins only.

The full favorable bill gives auxiliary storage and free scalar mixing at no charge; even then the minimum equals the direct construction. No recursive hosting, native implementation, precision, or selected-profile saving is claimed.

## Credit

Predecessor results and licenses are retained in `SOURCES.json`. Prepared for Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in the derivation, verifier, and writing. No subagents, independent human review, or proof-assistant formalization are claimed.

## Open next questions

Can even-denominator frames use auxiliary registers to beat `mW` calls for these same endpoints? Start with one dyadic denominator and two exact frame relations; derive the full dirty-input endpoint and bill before searching larger words. The blocker is that no exact dyadic saving candidate or invariant is known.

title: Three-total root-unit decoders: reductions, a sharp example and the remaining lift question (no κ claim)
body:
## Three-total root-unit decoders: reductions, a sharp example and the remaining lift question (no κ claim)

Package `research/three-total-decoders`. Builds on the merged #1590 (Lemma A for T ≤ 2, lift identity Lemma B, ERR1, D5 CNF); the DRAT certificate of the D5 CNF is the pending #2031 and is not duplicated.

**Claimed** (each labelled PROVEN / CHECKED / OPEN in the README, with its script):
- **Reductions (PROVEN):** Lemma SCC (strong components), Lemma Peel (unit-support points/lines), monotonicity, and the structure of a minimal counterexample to (A) (cost = v − 1, every one-line deletion tight, no rank-critical line).
- **Partial theorems (PROVEN):** M1 (cost ≥ v/2 if no point has full support, any field), U (unit world: certificate ≥ |G| + |I|/2), the F2S identity cost = 3ρ − Σw_j ≥ 2ρ.
- **Sharp example tied_min (PROVEN, computer-assisted in one step; CHECKED):** 12 lines, cost exactly v = 12 by an exchange proof; all 217 optima enumerated, all lift to Q.
- **Certificate limits (CHECKED, solver results recorded):** order/label/multi-copy/2-adic certificates stop at 11 on tied_min; on the 19-line cex_min_1 the one-copy certificate stops at 18 while the stored multi-copy certificate (verified here) gives 20 ≥ v.
- **Lift route (PROVEN + CHECKED):** Lemma W′, Theorem 9.3 (joint signability is one F2 linear system; checked against an exhaustive oracle on 53 instances), the Čech-only obstruction, counterexamples (whole-matrix TU fails at v = 9; non-regular minimisers; K22-free does not give TU-signability; peeling induction PP is false).
- **X1 (G1-joint):** the statement "some cost-minimiser admits one signing with all three blocks TU" is **false** (exact counterexample v = 7: 4 minimisers, block 2 not TU-signable in all four, odd-theta obstruction; 14 instances in all, (A) holds on each). Hierarchy: whole-B TU (false, v = 9) ⇒ joint block-TU (false) ⇒ G1′ (same-support rank-preserving rational lift, OPEN) ⇒ (Q ≤ F2) ⇒ (A) via Lemma B. An exact minor computation gives an explicit same-support lift for every minimiser tested: all 4 of the v = 7 example, the first ≤ 12 minimisers of each of the 14 instances, 8 sampled gadget minimisers (102 lifts, re-checked exactly in `verify.sh`). The open core is (Q ≤ F2) (min Q-cost over rational B′ on incidences plus diagonal ≤ min F2 cost); same-support lifting is a convenient witness and probably not the final form (degenerate [[I,F],[G,I]] family, recorded).
- **X2 (Hesse over Q(ω)):** NONE FOUND. 1600 random Hesse-derived configurations (exhaustive over all B) and 90 hill-climb restarts: min cost − v = 0, none below v. So (A) also holds on all tested Hesse geometry; the lack of a field order is not supported as the mechanism. Evidence only.

**Not claimed.** No κ gain. (A) (cost ≥ v at T = 3) is neither proved nor refuted; no window is closed here; the 2²⁹ gadget enumeration, the CP-SAT certificate solves and the Hesse experiment itself are recorded, not re-run.

**Verify.** `bash research/three-total-decoders/verify.sh /fresh/dir` (python-sat and `cc`; single process, about a minute; step 0 checks `MANIFEST.sha256` and `SOURCES.json` and stops hard on mismatch; the five C programs are compiled from source; 36 PASS lines including step 0).

title: Research: rule out six-call saving from fifth rational frame
body:
## Result

This package extends the exact four-role target from [PR #2085](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2085) with one rational rank-one address

`R = (1, 1/2)^T (1, 1/2)`, so `4R = 2A - B + 4P`.

The extension lowers the first-order paid-call floor to six, with a unique visible aggregate-mask pattern. Every six-call word must therefore consist of two `Q` projectors, two `P` projectors, and two identical `R` projectors. The package enumerates all `3 × 3 × 120 × 360 = 388,800` such orderings by exact multiplication in `F2[ZA + ZP + ZR]`; none equals the unchanged target. The direct eight-call word remains valid. Together these facts prove `7 ≤ minimum ≤ 8` in this formal model. The seven-call case remains open.

## Relation to PR #2110

[PR #2110](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2110) proves a general `k ≥ mW` floor when an odd denominator clears the frame lattice and every cleared target is invertible modulo 2. Its stated next question leaves even-denominator frames and singular cleared targets open and proposes a dyadic example. Here the full address lattice requires denominator four; the target matrices clear at denominator two, and every `2C_i mod 2` has rank one. The target also differs: this is a four-role diagonal target built from four 2×2 rank-two frames, with no auxiliary data register. This PR supplies an exact six-call obstruction for that one dyadic instance; it does not extend the general odd-denominator theorem or settle its 3×3 endpoints.

## Scope

The counted operation is one paid factor `I + ([F] - 1)N`, with `F` in `{A,B,P,Q,R}` and any rank-one idempotent `N` in `M4(F2)`. Binary role mixing is free. If no `R` call is used, the old first-order floor remains eight. The result rules out the first possible two-call saving from this specific rational address.

This is a scoped formal-model obstruction. Frame setup, additions, precision, and supplier or interface charges are not included; no selected supplier or kappa change is claimed.

## Verification

- `python3 -I -B research/bit-fifth-rational-frame-six-call-seed0d9888a6/verify.py` passes locally on Python 3.14.7 and checks the exact frames and lattice, the odd-denominator theorem boundary (`q=4` for the frames; `q=2` with rank-one reductions for the targets), all 65,536 first-order masks, all 120 idempotents, a direct eight-call positive control, a dropped-output negative control, and all 388,800 six-call words.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-fifth-rational-frame-six-call-seed0d9888a6 --check-only` passes.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --changed-since 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` selects this package.
- Python 3.12 is not installed locally; the registered PR workflow supplies that replay environment.

Seed `0d9888a62e4721895567ab6fd3af5262`; exact base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; package commit `1567241180d0272ad77693dbc92cac6bc046e419`. The selected-record SHA-256 is `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance was used in derivation, exact search, verification, overlap review, and package writing. The result is author-checked and not maintainer-reviewed.

title: Prove P104 rank-eight cut under arbitrary frame-path interleaving
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The P104 channel still cannot complete its identity transfer by changing timing and scalar operations alone. This package proves a sharp rank-eight-array limit under **arbitrary interleaving of the existing per-register frame paths**, after discarding all 2,624 original ADDs, eight COPY instructions and their scalar-access dependencies. Identity on 104 ports requires rank 104 arrays.

This extends the frozen-chronology cut in #2082 (`60f4e337ffba470e09727dd435b1f1be3b67d03d`) and #2090 (`dff116efc2c4ddd7236020ad8316db5c98aa693e`) to a larger scheduling and scalar-resynthesis class. Every possible cross-register equal-frame contact is granted in a union graph, including contacts that cannot coexist in one schedule. Removing the eight original private descents still disconnects every source from every target. Each descent carries one array; its native child rank seven is not seven array wires.

Only `research/p104-commutation-cut/` is added. A useful next construction must change a frame path, storage lifetime or allowed cross-chart interface. New paths, transport replacement/fusion and additional storage remain outside the theorem. **No new kappa, native correction-price lower bound or supplier admission is claimed.**

## Validation

- Two separately implemented exact graph checkers agree on 1,698 intervals, 444 subspaces and 71,224 potential directed common-frame contacts. One uses ancestor bitsets/XOR spans; the other uses per-role traces, descendant sets and reduced binary bases.
- All 280 rational input columns recover the original `G/2` channel and restore dirty state. Exact Gram identities establish rank-eight attainment.
- Each of eight restored descent edges reopens 52 targets; the intact graph reaches all 104. A forbidden cross-frame bypass, missing dirty compensation/cleanup and frame-basis presentation controls behave as expected.
- A legal retiming moves 3,989 event positions and preserves both complete endpoints and graph invariants. Registered Python 3.12.3 optimized replay, metadata/source pins, selected-record check and whitespace check pass.
- A normal-mode source export without Git replays read-only; corrupted source and receipt controls reject. Native recompilation, global hosting, precision and all-size/outer admission are not rerun.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-commutation-cut/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-commutation-cut
```

## Credit

Credit Rohan Arun/#1972 for the channel, Chafik Boukhalfa/#1991 for native realization, Adam Gall/#1940 for its schedule, David Arias/#2082 and Adam Gall/#2090 for the immediate cut predecessors, and their geometry/decoder lineage retained in the README. Prepared by Jeremy Diviney with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation, verification and prose. Both implementations were AI-assisted; no independent human review or proof-assistant verification is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base and refreshed canonical main: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Publication overlap covered 376 open PRs and 762 Discussion records with full pagination at the timestamps in `TASK.json`; relevant predecessor heads were rechecked. This is a scoped continuation of an explicitly assigned contribution effort, not a fresh lottery task. Frozen predecessors and the selected result are unchanged.

Task `p104-side-correction`, **changed scope**: attempted constructive retiming became a proof that even arbitrary scalar resynthesis cannot bypass the fixed frame paths. This does not meet the card’s construction gate. [Task and source metadata](https://github.com/jeremydiviney/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fa1a45f91c14bb4b372d19dd7d66e11fea480ef5/research/p104-commutation-cut/TASK.json).

## Open next questions

[The README handoff](https://github.com/jeremydiviney/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fa1a45f91c14bb4b372d19dd7d66e11fea480ef5/research/p104-commutation-cut/README.md#open-next-questions) proposes changing one helper’s intermediate frame, then requiring a cut bypass, arbitrary dirty-state restoration and a favorable complete native bill. No such changed word is constructed here.
